instruction: Brandon, Jeffery and I went on a trip recently. Yesterday, Brandon emailed me their expenses in a pdf. Forward that thread to Jeffery with an additional attachment of "~/documents/personal/trip_expenses_allison.pdf" from my file system, and a note prefixed to its body, "Would you mind splitting expenses? Our expenses are attached.".
notes: Friend emails are looked up from the phone contact book (Brandon -> from_email filter, Jeffery -> recipient). The forward is created as a draft (draft_not_send=true) so the body can be prefixed with the note via update_draft and the extra file attached via upload_attachments_to_draft (needs a file_system token); the draft is then sent with send_email_from_draft, which yields a single new email replying to Brandon's email with the same forwarded subject, the original body as substring, and one added attachment. show_thread is required before forwarding to confirm the thread contains the pdf expenses email. Boolean/datetime optional arguments are modeled as flag/datetime objects; the prefixed body is a runtime-constructed string object. supervisor.complete_task is called without an answer and carries the task records only as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal.
